Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Kevin Willis?

Kevin Willis is 63 years old.

Where was Kevin Willis born?

Kevin Willis was born in Los Angeles, California.

When was Kevin Willis born?

Kevin Willis was born on September 6, 1962.

How tall is Kevin Willis?

Kevin Willis is 7-0 (213 cm) tall.

How much did Kevin Willis weigh when playing?

Kevin Willis weighed 220 lbs (99 kg) when playing.

Is Kevin Willis in the Hall of Fame?

Kevin Willis is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Kevin Willis drafted?

Kevin Willis was drafted by Atlanta Hawks, 1st round (11th pick, 11th overall), 1984 NBA Draft.

What position did Kevin Willis play?

Power Forward and Center.

When did Kevin Willis retire?

Kevin Willis last played in 2007.

What is Kevin Willis' net worth?

Kevin Willis made at least $31,565,500 playing professional basketball.

How much did Kevin Willis make?

Kevin Willis made $3,650,000 in 1996.

What did Kevin Willis average?

Kevin Willis averaged 12.1 points, 8.4 rebounds, and 0.9 assists per game.

How many rings does Kevin Willis have?

Kevin Willis won one championship.

What schools did Kevin Willis attend?

Kevin Willis attended Pershing in Detroit, Michigan and Michigan State.

What are Kevin Willis' nicknames?

Devo, Fresh, T-Rex, Big Smoothie, Motown are nicknames for Kevin Willis.
